# Icon pack: Lucide

- Pack: [lucide-icons/lucide](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide), pinned by the committed license in `LICENSE` (ISC; Feather-derived icons are MIT).
- Style: 24dp grid, 2dp stroke, round caps/joins, `currentColor` tint source.
- App logo and splash artwork are original and stay as-is.
- The DuckDuckGo favicon and the grain/noise texture are artwork, not UI icons.
